trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (plain mean of the full pool) and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable. action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with no seasonality, high inter-model error correlation (mean 0.903, only 2 independent groups out of 19), and unstable ranking across windows (Kendall tau 0.166). With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights carry high estimation variance. The plain mean of the full pool already captures the consensus signal robustly, and no alternative strategy in the history achieves a statistically distinguishable improvement. The indistinguishable verdict confirms the runner-up is not meaningfully better.
